opening:
An earthquake has struck your city. You have reached safety, but your home is no longer accessible, and you are separated from someone you love. With calls and messages failing, you have no way to arrange where to meet.

Your favorite café comes to mind, but they may be heading toward their favorite museum. Even if you choose the same place, you could miss each other by arriving at different times.

To decide where to go and when, you need to consider what the other person will be thinking. They face the same problem: each of you is trying to anticipate the other’s choice.
